items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: you worked for Chick Gorman, the guy who ran the club.

ctx.x: When was that that he wanted you?

This was during the time I was on 52nd Street. But I had signed several contracts. I had a contract then with Raymond Scott on those radio broadcasts he was doing, and I had one in the club. You know, like on 52nd street when you worked in a club, if you worked in a band like Tiny Grimes band, you really didn't work for Tiny, you worked for Chick Gorman, the guy who ran the club. And if he figured you had a little name, well, he would give you a little more money. You know, sometimes you'd be making more money…

I was just tied up enough not to be able to do that thing, you know. And then Norman Granz would come through, and I'd try to keep myself free that I could go on some of those things with Norman. I did do several -- about three of those tours with Norman.
